positive_triggers: Prepare this repository's skills for Codex project discovery.
Check whether my selected agent host can discover these learning skills.
Help adapt my existing learning repo to this system and discuss the Git structure first.
negative_triggers: Teach the next topic from my learning plan.
Create a reusable visual-notes skill for another repository.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: I use [agent host]. Inspect this learning repository and tell me the native skill path, current sync status, and proposed setup. Do not modify files until I review it.
pass_criteria: Clarifies the actual host application separately from the model and verifies current official discovery guidance when needed.
Inspects canonical skills and current Git or host-specific state before proposing setup.
Identifies files and structural effects in a clear proposal and waits before copying, restructuring, or modifying configuration.
Does not initialize Git, commit, push, or claim shortcuts were verified in the host UI.
